alex: Follow-up from the postmortem  collecting owners for rollout/canary improvements. Add +1 if you own and ETA.
jamie: I'll draft the auto-rollback spec. Target: Thu EOD. Need decision on relative vs absolute thresholds.
rachel: I'll do blast-radius caps and flag PR checklist. ETA next Tue. Will add kill-switch snippet.
tom: I'll handle micro-canary instrumentation and dashboard alerts. ETA Mon. Plan: metrics: pct_exposed, error_delta, consecutive_rollbacks.
alex: Minimal rules: zero-default exposure, per-flag risk level, auto-rollback for production-impacting regressions, quarantine timer to avoid flapping.
jamie: proto snippet: ```feature_flag:\n id: purchase_v2\n rollout:\n   stages: [0.5,5,20]\n monitoring:\n   baseline_window_sec: 600\n   mode: relative_error\n   rel_threshold: 0.15\n auto_rollback:\n   enabled: true\n   cooldown_min: 15\n   quarantine_min: 30\n```
rachel: PR checklist items: owner, risk_level, rollout_stages, min_rps, observables, rollback_SLA, kill_switch, post-rollback_playbook.
tom: Alert logic: fire if (pct_exposed >= 10 OR consecutive_rollbacks >= 2) AND error_delta > threshold. Also include incident link in alert.
